content: Original curator paraphrase of John Bollinger's primary rules: traditional bands combine a simple moving average with standard deviation; twenty periods and two deviations are defaults. A band contact alone is not a trading signal, and an outside close can continue a trend. This lab therefore declares a separate closed-price outside-to-inside confirmation hypothesis rather than buying every low band contact. The population-variance convention, strict boundaries, inward price movement, range context and exact confirmation rule are lab choices; the publisher has not qualified this combined rule or its profitability.
